name: The Resistance
summary: A social deduction party game where Resistance members try to identify hidden government spies infiltrating missions.
rules_text: 5-10 players. One third rounded up are secretly Spies, rest are Resistance; Spies learn each other with eyes closed. Play missions 1-5. Each round the next Leader clockwise proposes a team size per table (2-4 players depending on count). All players publicly discuss then simultaneously vote approve/reject. If majority approves, team goes on mission; else leadership passes left. After 5 rejections on same mission, Spies win. For mission, each chosen player secretly plays Success (Resistance must play Success) or Fail (Spy option). Shuffle and reveal: 1 Fail fails mission (2 fails needed on mission 4 with 7+ players). First team to 3 successful or failed mission points wins.
